scripts.desktop:build: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.main.config.ts && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.preload.config.ts && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:start: npm run desktop:build && node node_modules/electron/cli.js apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:5173 && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --watch --config apps/desktop/vite.main.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:5173 && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --watch --config apps/desktop/vite.preload.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node node_modules/electron/cli.js apps/desktop"
scripts.test:smoke:desktop: npm run desktop:build && playwright test tests/e2e/desktop/preview.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.test:smoke:live: npm run desktop:build && cross-env TLC_RUN_LIVE_SMOKE=1 playwright test tests/e2e/desktop/live.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.validate:major: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:smoke:desktop
scripts.phase0:check: npm run check:structure && npm run preflight && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
